name: woocommerce/shipping-zone-method-create
label: Add shipping method to zone
description: Add a flat rate, free shipping or local pickup method to a shipping zone, with its settings. Zone 0 covers every location no other zone matches.

enabled.description: Whether customers can choose the method at checkout.

order.description: Position of the method in its zone. Lower comes first.

settings.description: Settings to change. Flat rate and local pickup take title, tax_status and cost. Free shipping takes title, requires, min_amount and ignore_discounts.

cost.description: Cost before tax, such as "5" or a formula like "10 + [qty] * 2". [qty] is the number of items, [cost] the order cost, and [fee percent="10" min_fee="2"] a percentage fee.

requires.description: What earns free shipping: nothing, a free shipping coupon, the minimum amount, either one, or both. Sending min_amount alone on a method with no requirement sets this to min_amount.

min_amount.description: Order amount that earns free shipping, as a decimal string without a currency symbol.

ignore_discounts.description: Whether the minimum applies to the order amount before coupon discounts.

settings.description: Settings such as cost or min_amount, as stored. Only for the flat rate, free shipping and local pickup methods.
